siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Villa Crespi
siblings.summary: What to do within a 30 km radius of Villa Crespi on Lake Orta — Sacro Monte, Borromean Islands, Mottarone, Villa Taranto, design pilgrimage in Omegna, plus prices, hours, and what late-May actually delivers.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Villa Crespi
siblings.summary: Boutique, historic and one-of-a-kind places to sleep within a short taxi or walk of Villa Crespi on Lake Orta.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Villa Crespi
siblings.summary: Within 30 km of Villa Crespi the IT-conference circuit is thin: one upcoming event (TEDxVerbania, 21 Nov 2026) plus two invite-only spring events that just wrapped — Ambrosetti Technology Forum (Stresa) and AUSED CIO Leaders Summit (Baveno).

sources.title: villacrespi.it · Our location
sources.claim: Villa Crespi address is Via Fava 18; 10-min walk to historic center; 600 m to Sacro Monte; 800 m to Orta-Miasino station

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Villa Crespi
sources.claim: Villa Crespi rated 4.7/5 from 1,910 reviews; ranked #1 of 11 hotels; 14 rooms; rooms $466–$1,450/night

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Villa Pinin
sources.claim: Villa Pinin B&B at Via Fava 12, four rooms, 20 m from Lake Orta, rated 4.7/5; double rooms €80–€120; not all rooms have en-suite bath

sources.title: villapinin.com
sources.claim: Villa Pinin is a 4-bedroom B&B in a private garden along the panoramic promenade leading to Orta's historic center

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Hotel La Bussola
sources.claim: Hotel La Bussola at Strada Panoramica 24, rated 4.2/5 from 472 reviews, #3 of 11 hotels; 7-min downhill walk to center; rooms $185–$376

sources.title: hotelbussolaorta.it
sources.claim: Hotel La Bussola on Via Panoramica 24 promontory with pool, free parking, lake-view restaurant

sources.title: albergoleondoro.it
sources.claim: Hotel Leon d'Oro is a 3-star hotel at Piazza Motta 42; 200-year family hotel; two lake terraces; on-site spa

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Hotel Leon d'Oro
sources.claim: Hotel Leon d'Oro location rated 9.7/10 by 739 Booking guests; historic-center square with lake and island views

sources.title: Expedia · Hotel Aracoeli
sources.claim: Hotel Aracoeli at Piazza Motta 34, beside the ferry dock to San Giulio Island; check-in is at Piccolo Hotel Olina; pedestrian-only zone

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Hotel San Rocco
sources.claim: Hotel San Rocco at Via Gippini 11, 3.6/5 from 897 reviews, #5 of 11 hotels; converted 16C monastery; pool and lakefront restaurant

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Al Dom B&B
sources.claim: Al Dom B&B at Via Giovanetti 57, three rooms in 18C building on Sacro Monte side; rated 4.8/5 from 158 reviews; #1 of 3 B&Bs

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Locanda di Orta
sources.claim: Locanda di Orta guesthouse is 50 m from Lake Orta in pedestrian zone; rated 3.9/5 from 220 reviews; rooms small

sources.title: Michelin Guide · Locanda di Orta
sources.claim: Locanda di Orta restaurant (chef Andrea Monesi) holds one Michelin star in the 2026 Guide Italia

sources.title: Expedia · Piccolo Hotel Olina
sources.claim: Piccolo Hotel Olina at Via Olina 40 in pedestrian medieval village; 2-min walk to Piazzetta and ferries; rooms across several restored buildings

sources.title: Trip.com · Villa Crespi map
sources.claim: Piccolo Hotel Olina is approximately 0.5 mi (~800 m) from Villa Crespi

sources.title: TripAdvisor · Hotel Bocciolo
sources.claim: Hotel Bocciolo at Via Domodossola 26 is roughly 30 minutes on foot from Orta's historic center
